issues: gson/src/main/java/com/google/gson/stream/JsonReader.java::method::JsonReader.doPeek::21726: says the ']' fall-through (for lenient ",]") goes to END_ARRAY, but in the source the fall-through lands in the ';'/',' case and yields a lenient PEEKED_NULL placeholder, while END_ARRAY only comes from ']' when peekStack is EMPTY_ARRAY.

gson/src/main/java/com/google/gson/stream/JsonReader.java::method::JsonReader.nextNonWhitespace::53619: says a lone '/' is returned, but checkLenient() is called after the '/' is seen and before the peek switch, so in STRICT or LEGACY_STRICT mode any '/' that does not start a comment throws MalformedJsonException instead of being returned.

gson/src/main/java/com/google/gson/stream/JsonReader.java::method::JsonReader.nextDouble::36053: states that on success the literal is recorded via recordPromotedName, but the PEEKED_LONG early return skips recordPromotedName (and the same applies to nextLong and nextInt's PEEKED_LONG early returns).
